items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is day-to-day with a rib injury after exiting Week 1; Harbaugh said the team will monitor how he feels this week before deciding Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Hard hit on catch late Q3; did not return; Harbaugh DTD label
items.implication: Monitor Wed-Fri practice; uncertain WR1 for LAC if limited/out
items.opportunity: If out/limited, expanded targets for other LAC WRs including Quentin Johnston

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak now considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after meniscus trim; realistic chance he returns Week 2 at Chargers after missing Week 1.
items.why: Meniscus trim last week; recovery tracking better than typical multi-week timeline
items.implication: Potential TE1 return elevates Raiders passing; reverse Mayer standalone if Bowers IN
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer held TE1 role in Week 1 (6-32 on 7 targets); usage shrinks if Bowers active

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers suffered a hamstring injury not considered serious; DTD, would have returned if playoff game; coach Jesse Minter confirmed DTD. MRI pending but positive early returns.
items.why: Hamstring not serious per sources; left early vs Colts after big start
items.implication: Likely available Week 2 if practice progresses; top Lamar target when healthy
items.opportunity: Lane already OUT longer-term creates some residual WR opportunity if Flowers sits

items.text: Lions offense extremely concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No real RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected for efficient Lions attack; four players dominate touches/targets
items.implication: Lock in the core four; fade DET depth pieces for fantasy

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7/7 targets) but got only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy; strong matchup vs CLE next.
items.why: Goal-line monopoly + route edge over Gainwell + health confirmation
items.implication: Lead back with receiving and GL work; start with confidence Week 2
items.opportunity: Sole RB carry inside 10; 21-13 route win vs Gainwell
items.conflict: Box score inflated by TD efficiency relative to raw volume

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays would change view. Berry wants all the Loveland and is buying low.
items.why: Elite route rate despite quiet production; preseason belief in Bears offense intact
items.implication: Buy-low TE/WR flex with massive snap/route foundation
items.opportunity: 92% routes signals locked-in role even if targets lagged Week 1
items.conflict: Berry also flagged Loveland among Week 1 concerns in recap pod

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne did not dominate more with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53-26-15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24-7-5; opportunities 18-9-4. Committee persists.
items.why: Kamara inactive yet Etienne shared meaningfully with Miller/Donaldson
items.implication: Etienne not a clear workhorse even in Kamara absence; temper expectations
items.opportunity: Still led but not dominant; Miller/Donaldson retained roles
items.conflict: Some expected full takeover with Kamara out

items.text: Malik Nabers active in first game since ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), team-high 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0, emerged healthy. Late decision to play.
items.why: Decided ~2 hours pre-kick; family not even there; efficient target share on limited snaps
items.implication: Ramp-up path clear; startable WR1/2 with path to full workload
items.opportunity: 71% routes already with 31% target share post-major knee injury

items.text: ETR weekend status summary: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and Rome Odunze (calf) expected to play; Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected; Malik Nabers (knee) no news yet (later active).
items.implication: Kamara out drove Etienne committee watch; Love/Odunze cleared path; Nabers pending resolved active
items.opportunity: Etienne volume bump (partial) with Kamara out

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks; even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Limited passing-game involvement despite backfield attrition
items.implication: More of a pure rusher/committee piece than three-down fantasy RB
items.opportunity: Low route share caps PPR ceiling

items.text: Dalton Kincaid appears over PCL issue: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Josh Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
items.why: High snap and route rates in return to full involvement
items.implication: TE1 upside back on track with Allen

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season is well under way per Berry after Week 1.
items.why: Strong Week 1 production in Ravens TE usage
items.implication: Elevate Likely in TE rankings/ROS; stream or start with confidence

items.text: Berry: risk/reward if decoy but starting Malik Nabers everywhere after he was ruled active.
items.why: Active designation enough to start despite injury ramp risk
items.implication: Validated by subsequent 31% target share and healthy exit

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out with wrist injury; longer-term than Flowers per subsequent coaching comments.
items.why: Wrist injury; ruled out Week 1 and flagged longer absence
items.implication: Removes young Ravens WR from short-term waivers/DFS; Flowers DTD more central
items.opportunity: Slight residual target bump to other BAL WRs if Flowers also limited
